[FACT] The user is considering upgrading the lighting in their living room.  
[PREFERENCE] The user is looking for minimalist shades that let in more natural light.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Roller shades are a classic choice for minimalist design, simple, sleek, and easy to operate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Solar shades block UV rays and heat while allowing natural light to enter, available in different opacity levels.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cellular shades, also known as honeycomb shades, provide insulation and are available in various light-filtering fabrics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Plantation shutters provide a clean, simple look and filter natural light while maintaining openness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sliding panels consist of large panels that slide back and forth to control natural light and can be made from light-filtering fabrics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When selecting a shade, consider opacity, material, operating system, and color/pattern.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular brands for window shades include Hunter Douglas, Levolor, Bali, Graber, and Somfy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Before making a decision, measure windows accurately, read reviews, and consider consulting with a window treatment expert.

[PREFERENCE] The user is looking for lamp options that provide a warm, soft glow.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Table lamps with warm-toned shades in linen or silk provide a soft, gentle light.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ceramic or glass table lamps can add a warm feel to the bedside table.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] LED lamps with a color temperature around 2700K-3000K provide a warm, soft glow and are energy-efficient.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dimmable table lamps allow for adjustable light levels, perfect for creating a cozy atmosphere.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular brands for bedside lamps include Crate & Barrel, West Elm, Pottery Barn, CB2, and IKEA.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The lifespan of incandescent bulbs is 1,000 to 2,000 hours, halogen bulbs 2,000 to 4,000 hours, LED bulbs 15,000 to 25,000 hours, and CFLs 8,000 to 10,000 hours.
